candidates.title: Move Sign In After Pet Customization
candidates.change: Move account sign-in to take place after pet adoption choice and certificate creation so users build connection before creating an account.
candidates.why: Funnel drop-off occurs early and 8 support tickets report confusion around signing in with the wrong account losing pets.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in to take place after adoption setup is explicitly allowed by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign-in after pet adoption addresses sign_in drop-off and strong support email feedback.

candidates.title: Interactive Controls Guide Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated interactive controls guide screen before final launch teaching users how to drag, hide, and interact with desktop pets.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets specifically mention confusion around controlling, hiding, or talking to the pet after onboarding.

new_controls_guide.headline: Learn How to Interact With Your Pet
new_controls_guide.body: Try clicking, dragging, and right-clicking your companion to access actions.

guard.reason: Adding a new interactive controls guide screen inside onboarding is allowed by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Adding a new controls screen addresses finish step drop-off and 3 support tickets, but requires a new release.

candidates.title: Redesign Pick Friend Grid Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the pet selection screen into a visual grid layout showcasing ready-to-adopt pets with instant preview cards.
candidates.why: Adoption step has high drop-off (60.9% conversion) and support noted custom pet generation errors.

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Desktop Display Verification Flow
candidates.change: Insert a desktop visibility check sub-flow right after waiting step to confirm pet overlay renders correctly.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported pets failing to show on desktop or app not opening after setup.

new_desktop_check.headline: Verifying Desktop Visibility
new_desktop_check.body: Checking screen overlay permissions and display bounds.

guard.reason: Adding a new verification sub-flow screen after waiting step is allowed by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Desktop verification check requires a new flow to fix rendering issues reported in 3 tickets.

candidates.title: Sign In Existing Account Notice
candidates.change: Add explicit hint text on sign in advising returning users to sign in with their existing account to restore pets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or account reset after signing back in.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with your original account to restore previous pets and desktop items.

guard.reason: Adding an account restoration hint to the sign-in screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Config-only hint text directly addresses 8 support emails regarding lost pet accounts.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Tips Carousel
candidates.change: Add a dynamic tips carousel and precise progress ETA on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Waiting step in adoption/home phase takes median 89s to 201s, leading to drop-offs.

components.text: Right click your pet anytime on your desktop for quick actions.

guard.reason: Updating waiting screen information with a real estimate and tips carousel is permitted by Rules 4 and 5.

candidates.score_note: Tips carousel mitigates user friction during the long wait time on the home/adoption phase.

candidates.title: Clarify Path Choice Headline
candidates.change: Update headline and body on path selection screen to clearly distinguish quick preset adoption vs custom creation.
candidates.why: Choose path screen takes median 8s but mean 514s, indicating initial user hesitation.

choose_path.headline: How Would You Like to Meet Your Companion?
choose_path.body: Choose an instant ready-to-play pet or design a custom companion.

guard.reason: Clarifying copy on path selection screen while retaining both adoption options preserves the job required by Rule 2.

candidates.score_note: Simple copy update to clarify path choice helps reduce high mean time on initial step.

candidates.title: Starter Accessory Adoption Badge
candidates.change: Display an unlocked starter item badge on the adoption certificate screen as an extra adoption reward.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is low (60.9%) and needs stronger completion motivation.

guard.reason: Adding an unlocked starter toy badge violates Rule 3, which prohibits onboarding copy from mentioning free extras or gifts.

candidates.title: Background Desktop Notification Toggle
candidates.change: Enable desktop notification prompt on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet rendering completes.
candidates.why: Mean waiting time before home screen is high (2336s), causing users to lose track of setup.

waiting.hint: We'll send a notification when your desktop pet is ready to spawn!

guard.reason: Adding desktop notification settings to the waiting screen is explicitly allowed by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Notification prompt helps re-engage users during the long background waiting period.

candidates.title: Split Controls Cheatsheet Layout
candidates.change: Change home_intro layout to split format containing a desktop controls cheatsheet component.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets asked how to control and manage the desktop pet post-onboarding.

guard.reason: Redesigning the home intro screen layout within onboarding is allowed by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Layout modification provides controls clarity at the finish step without building a whole new screen.

picked: Move Sign In After Pet Customization

decisions.title: Move Sign In After Pet Customization

shipped: Move Sign In After Pet Customization
